## Work Experience

### Kreditožrouti — Creator & Sole Maintainer (own product, since Sep 2025)
Course scheduler for VŠE students, live at kreditozrouti.cz and used by 300+ students. Created and run solo, from InSIS scraping to deployments. Runs with monitoring, alerting and automatic deployments. Grew out of a first-place hackathon build and led to Jan's bachelor thesis (an MCP server over InSIS data on university servers).
Stack: TypeScript, Vue.js, Node.js, Redis, BullMQ, Docker, Traefik, CI/CD

### CORAC Engineering — Senior Frontend Engineer, B2B (Apr 2025 – Aug 2026)
Sole frontend engineer on DeepTrace, a zero-trust data provenance platform for Earth Observation data.
- Architected interactive D3.js lineage visualisation for complex supply-chain graphs
- Implemented client-side hash-chain verification following zero-trust architecture
- Integrated AWS Cognito (OAuth) for secure client-side authentication
Stack: Vue 3, TypeScript, D3.js, AWS Cognito, Vite, pnpm, Shadcn

### Intedat — Fullstack Engineer, B2B (Sep 2024 – Jun 2026)
Delivered features end to end on a data platform, from the Nuxt frontend through the AdonisJS backend to PostgreSQL and Redis.
- Owned feature delivery across the stack, Nuxt on the frontend, AdonisJS on the backend
- Rebuilt search on Elasticsearch across large datasets, tuning relevance and latency
- Ran CI/CD and DigitalOcean Linux infrastructure for production deployments
Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, Nuxt, AdonisJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

### Diář FISáka — Lead Backend Engineer & DevOps Architect (VŠE team project, Oct 2025 – Feb 2026)
Led four developers on a university platform. Set the Agile workflow, Git branching strategy and code review standards, wrote the technical documentation, and mentored on TypeScript, Docker and architectural patterns. Containerised infrastructure on a Hetzner VPS (Docker, Traefik, Cloudflare) with a Node.js REST API and BullMQ + Redis async workers.

### IONT tech — Fullstack Engineer, technical lead, B2B (Aug 2023 – Sep 2024)
Led an EV charging platform from bare infrastructure to live payments as the only fullstack engineer on it.
- Built the public charging app with online payments (ČSOB) and remote charger authorization
- Designed and deployed the whole environment from scratch on IaaS as Docker Swarm microservices
- Built an auto-updating firmware delivery system alongside the hardware team
Stack: SvelteKit, Fastify, TypeScript, Docker Swarm, MongoDB, Redis, Linux

### Smíchovská SPŠ — Lecturer & Organizer, Summer School (2022 – 2026, 4 editions)
Solo-taught an introductory 2D graphics course to 50 students per edition (ages 13 to 16). Wrote the curriculum, designed the final projects, reviewed every submission. Top-rated lecturer in every edition.

### Precismo — Fullstack Developer (Jan 2023 – Nov 2023)
Fullstack developer on a cross-functional Agile team building an internal customer portal. Worked with 6 developers and 1 PM in Scrum.
Stack: React, Node.js, Playwright, SQL

### Haxagon — Frontend Developer, part-time (Oct 2022 – Jul 2023)
Built the frontend of a cybersecurity e-learning platform in Vue and TypeScript, and introduced code quality and release processes the team kept using.
Stack: Vue.js, TypeScript, Tailwind

## Site Technology

- Framework: SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 (runes: $state, $derived, $effect)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4
- Content: MDSvex (Markdown → Svelte components)
- i18n: svelte-i18n (English + Czech)
- Deployment: Cloudflare Workers via @sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare
- Validation: Zod v4
- Contact form: Submits to Discord webhook via /api/forms
- Analytics: Google Analytics (privacy-respecting, no PII)
